protocol_type: retrospective technical extension, not independently preregistered
external_data: US macrodata: real GDP, consumption, investment

comparison.json_schema: Typed nested schema only; a deliberately limited configuration, not a capability limit
comparison.pandera_local: Schema plus domain rules/internal relationships; no current versions or registry comparison
comparison.pandera_registered: Same input plus caller-held current versions and reference registry
comparison.native_registered: Direct implementation with the same rules and reference information as pandera_registered

C0_original: Observed forecast with a synthetic consistent review
C1_reordered: JSON key order changes without semantic change
C2_renewed_review: Review and caller-held current version both advance
F01_numeric_type: Prediction replaced by a numeric string
F02_horizon: Input period moved by one month
F03_arithmetic: Displayed forecast difference increased by one log point
F04_decomposition: One contribution increased without changing the forecast
F05_request_binding: Request changed while the stored review remains unchanged
F06_unverified_operation: Current snapshot represented as historically verified operation
F07_measurement_unit: Log change relabeled as percentage change
F08_stale_review: Caller-held current review version advances without renewed review
F09_coherent_forecast: Forecast and intercept jointly changed with updated internal hashes
F10_coherent_source: Source digest changed with updated internal hashes
F11_coherent_model: Model artifact digest changed with updated internal hashes
F12_coherent_validation: Validation count/summary changed while retaining arithmetic consistency

reference_boundary: Jointly changing submitted and trusted reference data is outside assumptions; report separately
